Metadata.description: Fullstack developer with experience in Node, Nest.js, PHP, Laravel, React, Next.js and Vue. Focused on building solid, accessible and well-tested web applications.

Home.subtitle: I build end-to-end web applications with Node, PHP, Laravel, React, Vue.js, Nest.js and Next.js. I care about clean code, performance and accessible experiences.

highlights.backendDesc: REST APIs and services in PHP, Laravel, Node, Nest.js and Express. Data modeling with MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
highlights.frontendDesc: Accessible, fast UIs with React, Next.js, Vue.js and Tailwind. Thoughtful UX, responsive by default.
highlights.devopsDesc: Docker, CI/CD, deploys on AWS, Google Cloud, Netlify and Vercel. Testing, monitoring and basic observability.

About.title: About me
About.lead: I'm a fullstack developer passionate about building useful, well-crafted software.
paragraphs: My main focus is the backend with Node, Nest.js, PHP and Laravel, complemented with relational databases (MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB). On the client side I work with React, Next.js, Vue.js and Tailwind.
I'm motivated by collaborating with teams, writing code others can read effortlessly, and shipping products that solve real problems.
